WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
  FROM Customers AS c
  JOIN Orders AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.gender IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.gender
),
shares AS (
  SELECT customer_id, gender, order_count,
         1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER (PARTITION BY gender) AS order_share
  FROM customer_orders
)
SELECT customer_id, gender, order_count, order_share,
       order_share - AVG(order_share) OVER () AS above_average
FROM shares
WHERE order_share > AVG(order_share) OVER ()
ORDER BY above_average DESC
LIMIT 10
